wire.t: The Colts released Daniel Jones on Friday, the day after he went 12 of 27 for 144 yards in a 26-3 loss to Houston. Shane Steichen named Anthony Richardson Sr. the starter going forward, beginning in Week 12 against the Giants. Jones is still on the Asian Jim roster; Richardson is on the Kraft for Cash bench.

Baker Mayfield (foot, right thumb) is officially Questionable for Sunday at Detroit after limited practices Thursday and Friday. Todd Bowles said he "had a good day today" and is trending toward starting. Mayfield is on the Catfan94’s Farm Team bench; Jalon Daniels, the backup if he can't go, is on the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte bench.
Kenneth Walker III (groin) has been ruled Out for Kansas City against Arizona, his second straight missed game. He is not in the Catfan94’s Farm Team starting lineup.

Dalton Kincaid (thumb, ankle) is Doubtful after missing practice all week, and he is still in the OBJAY starting lineup at tight end as of Saturday morning. Oronde Gadsden and Tyler Higbee are on the bench.

Mike Evans (Achilles tendinitis) is Questionable for Sunday night in Mexico City; Kyle Shanahan said the 49ers will check him at Saturday's walkthrough. Bhayshul Tuten got no designation after a limited Friday. Both start for Jefferson’s Reserve.

Brock Bowers (ankle, quad) is Questionable after limited practices Thursday and Friday and starts for LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix. Ladd McConkey (back) is Questionable and starts for Asian Jim. Kyler Murray (hamstring) is Out and sits on the Asian Jim bench. Darren Waller is Questionable on the Hold My DK bench.
Rams coach Sean McVay said Puka Nacua had MCL surgery Tuesday and will be out "a couple months." Nacua is on the Hold My DK injured reserve.

As of Saturday morning, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte is the only team with a starter ruled Out or on bye: Drake Maye, who is out indefinitely with an ankle injury, is still in the quarterback slot. Justin Fields and Jalon Daniels are on the bench.

stories.title: The Colts cut Daniel Jones, and the quarterback who replaces him is sitting on the Kraft for Cash bench
stories.dek: Asian Jim loses its starting quarterback to a pink slip, BTaylor1 gets a free starter for the stretch run, and Baker Mayfield is trending toward playing.
body: One day after Daniel Jones scored 4.06 against Houston, Indianapolis released him. Shane Steichen announced it Friday and named Anthony Richardson Sr. the starter going forward, beginning with the Giants in Week 12. Jones goes on NFL waivers and becomes a free agent Monday afternoon if nobody claims him. His 4.06 for Asian Jim this week already counts. Every week after this, it's whatever team picks him up, if one does.

That leaves ManicOrientals with Tyler Shough and Kyler Murray, and Murray is Out again this week with a hamstring. Asian Jim was 5‑5 with three straight wins on Thursday morning. It's now a 30.5-point underdog to Catfan94’s Farm Team with its starting quarterback unemployed. In a superflex league, that's the whole ballgame for the next four weeks.

The winner is BTaylor1. Anthony Richardson Sr. has been sitting on the Kraft for Cash bench behind Bryce Young and Justin Herbert, and he's 24 with a starting job as of Friday. Kraft for Cash is 6‑4 and now has three starting quarterbacks for two spots. That's a trade chip with a waiting list, and I'd bet ManicOrientals is already typing.

Elsewhere: Baker Mayfield is Questionable but Todd Bowles says he's trending toward playing, which kills my $11 Jalon Daniels plan. Kenneth Walker III is Out and jrsmith1391 already has him on the bench. Dalton Kincaid is Doubtful and still in the OBJAY lineup. And Drake Maye is still in my quarterback slot on Saturday morning. He's out indefinitely with an ankle injury, New England is on bye, and none of that is the problem. The problem is the guy who sets the lineup. I'll fix it tonight. Justin Fields plays at 1:00.

stories.title: Four weeks left: Kraft for Cash is 6‑4, and The Champ, Jefferson’s Reserve and Asian Jim are all 5‑5
stories.dek: Six teams make it. The top three are close to locked. The tiebreaker is points for, and TJohn91 has the most of the 5‑5 teams by a lot.
body: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK are 9‑1. Catfan94’s Farm Team is 7‑3. Those three are at least two games clear of seventh place with four weeks to play, so the real fight is for spots four through six between Kraft for Cash at 6‑4 and three teams at 5‑5.

Points for is the tiebreaker. Among the 5‑5 teams: The Champ 1414.72, Jefferson’s Reserve 1253.50, Asian Jim 1191.98. TJohn91 is 161.22 points ahead of jmello16 and 222.74 ahead of ManicOrientals, which is almost two full weeks of scoring. If it's a three-way tie at the end, the two-time champ is in.

I Chase Brown Kids (1219.86) and OBJAY (1184.34) are 4‑6, one game back. Bourbon Lover and StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte are 3‑7 and need four straight wins and some help. Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑10 and mathematically eliminated: seven teams already have five wins, and Br0phy can finish with four at best.

This week's games that matter: Jefferson’s Reserve is a 22.3-point favorite over Bourbon Lover. Kraft for Cash is a 17.0-point favorite over OBJAY now that Geno Smith is Questionable. Catfan94’s Farm Team is a 27.7-point favorite over Asian Jim, with Smith-Njigba on bye. And The Champ gets me, a team whose quarterback depends on Baker Mayfield's ankle, so pencil TJohn91 in for 6‑5.

stories.title: Week 10: Hold My DK beats me by 117.42, Asian Jim steals Monday night, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑10
stories.dek: Two teams are 9‑1, four teams are fighting over three playoff spots, and I'm 3‑7 with no quarterback for Week 11.
body: Hold My DK 196.34, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 78.92. That's a 117.42-point margin, the biggest of the week and the second-biggest of the season behind Catfan94's 127.22 in Week 5. Christian McCaffrey had 50.3, Patrick Mahomes 45.92, and Derrick Henry added 16.5 on Monday night with two touchdowns on 10 yards rushing. Chuba Hubbard scored 35.7 on the bench. TheMoneyTeam2302 is 9‑1 and has scored 1582.92 points.

The game of the week happened Monday. Kraft for Cash led Asian Jim 89.30 to 84.06 going into Chargers at Ravens, and BTaylor1 had Zay Flowers left against three for ManicOrientals. Flowers scored 9.9. Omarion Hampton ran for 105 yards and a touchdown for 19.0, Tre' Harris caught five for 86 (12.6) and Justice Hill added 7.8. Final: Asian Jim 123.46, Kraft for Cash 99.20. ManicOrientals pulled Ladd McConkey for Harris before kickoff, and that move is worth a win. Asian Jim has won three straight and is 5‑5.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat Jefferson’s Reserve 232.54 to 134.62, the second-highest score in league history, and is 9‑1 with six straight wins. The Champ beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 166.08 to 68.10; Jacoby Brissett threw for 340 yards and scored 12.3, and Br0phy is 0‑10. Catfan94’s Farm Team beat OBJAY 138.94 to 83.62, and I Chase Brown Kids beat Bourbon Lover 124.46 to 116.92 in the closest game of the week.

Bad beat: Jefferson’s Reserve scored 134.62, the fifth-highest score of the week, and lost by 97.92. Low score: Dude, Your Getting a Dell at 68.10. And for the record, I scored 78.92 and started AJ Barner at superflex while Dalton Schultz (8.1) and Samaje Perine (13.9) sat on my bench. Swap those two in and I score 93.12 and lose by 103.22 instead of 117.42. Still the worst week of anyone not named Br0phy.

columns.title: THEY CUT HIM!! THE COLTS CUT DANIEL JONES AND Asian Jim IS STILL HOLDING THE RECEIPT!!
columns.dek: Hugh G. Rection read the Friday transaction wire and has not sat down since.
body: THEY CUT HIM!! FRIDAY!! ONE DAY AFTER 4.06!! THE COLTS LOOKED AT DANIEL JONES AND SAID 'NOPE' AND Asian Jim STILL HAS HIM ON THE ROSTER!! ManicOrientals HAD THREE STRAIGHT WINS ON THURSDAY MORNING!! BY FRIDAY NIGHT HIS QUARTERBACK DIDN'T HAVE A PARKING SPOT!!

AND WHO GETS THE JOB?! ANTHONY RICHARDSON SR.!! WHO'S HE OWNED BY?! BTaylor1!! SITTING ON THE Kraft for Cash BENCH!! BEHIND BRYCE YOUNG AND JUSTIN HERBERT!! HE DID NOTHING!! HE DID ABSOLUTELY NOTHING AND HE GOT A STARTING QUARTERBACK!! THAT'S LIKE FINDING A LOBSTER ROLL IN YOUR COUCH CUSHIONS!!
AND OBJAY!! DALTON KINCAID IS DOUBTFUL!! DIDN'T PRACTICE ONCE!! STILL IN THE LINEUP!! JAY2913 IS UP 11.7 AND IS TRYING TO GIVE IT BACK WITH A TIGHT END WHO'S GONNA BE IN A HOODIE!!

AND THE GUY WHO RUNS THIS SITE!! STILL!! SATURDAY!! A QUARTERBACK RULED OUT IN HIS LINEUP!! THE ONLY ONE IN THE LEAGUE!! JUSTIN FIELDS IS ON HIS BENCH, HEALTHY, PLAYING SUNDAY!! IT'S ONE CLICK!! ONE!! I NEED A DUNKIN' AND A LIE DOWN!!

columns.title: ManicOrientals has 48 hours to stop being polite and call BTaylor1
columns.dek: Richard "Dick" Gozinya says a superflex team without a quarterback isn't a contender. It's a donor.
body: Let's be clear about what happened Friday. Indianapolis released Daniel Jones and handed the job to Anthony Richardson Sr. Asian Jim lost its starting quarterback for the rest of the season and didn't make a single bad decision to do it. That happens. What happens next is on ManicOrientals.

Asian Jim is 5‑5. Kyler Murray is Out again. Tyler Shough is the depth chart. Four weeks left and the tiebreaker is points for, where Asian Jim is already 222.74 behind The Champ. You don't make that up with a backup. You make it up by going to the one manager with three starting quarterbacks and paying him.

That manager is BTaylor1. Kraft for Cash is 6‑4 and can only start two of Bryce Young, Justin Herbert and Richardson. He'll want a receiver. Jake Ferguson is Out and Tucker Kraft is on bye, so he'll want a tight end too. Give him one. When I played, the guys who won were the ones who hit first. Pick up the phone. Toughen up.

columns.title: Daniel Jones scored 4.06 and lost his job. By my math, that's worth 4.06 jobs.
columns.dek: Ivana Humpalot ran the Friday transaction wire through her spreadsheet and is very confident in what came out.
body: Daniel Jones went 12 of 27 for 144 yards Thursday, scored 4.06 for Asian Jim, and was released Friday. That's 144 yards per release, which my model says is the league's most efficient release rate this season. Nobody else has been released at all, so he's also the leader by infinity.

Anthony Richardson Sr. is 24 and on the Kraft for Cash bench. Jones is 29. That's a five-year age gap, and in dynasty each year is worth roughly 1.0 years, so BTaylor1 gained five years of quarterback overnight without making a transaction. That's 0 FAAB dollars per year, tied with jmello16 for the best rate in the league.

OBJAY leads Kraft for Cash 16.9 to 5.2, an 11.7-point lead. I moved the line 1.5 points toward Kraft for Cash because Dalton Kincaid is Doubtful. 11.7 divided by 1.5 is 7.8, which means OBJAY needs Kincaid to be 7.8 times more doubtful before it's a toss-up. I don't know what that looks like, but I've charted it.

Finally, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte has 0.0 points from the quarterback slot this week; the only points so far are Ashton Dulin's 4.5 at receiver. Projected quarterback points with the current lineup: 0.0. Projected with one click to Justin Fields: more than 0.0. That's an infinite percentage improvement, the second-largest in league history behind Jones' release rate.

columns.title: 5 Friday lineup moves from Holden McGroin, who once started a punter at flex 'for field position'
columns.dek: Thursday night is over. Holden McGroin has learned nothing from it and would like to share.
body: 1. Laquon Treadwell scored 0.0, which means he's due. Anybody who scores zero on Thursday is statistically owed points on Sunday. That's the law of averages. I don't know which law, but it's on the books somewhere.

2. Bill_Buttlicker should keep Drake Maye in the lineup. Everyone else in the league benched their bye-week players. When 11 guys zig, the 12th guy zags all the way to 3‑7. You can't argue with that record. I mean you can, it's bad, but you can't argue with it.
3. ManicOrientals, Daniel Jones scored 4.06, so start him again next week. A quarterback who got sacked for a safety is a quarterback who knows where the end zone is. You can't teach that.

4. jmello16, now is the time to spend FAAB. Not because you need anyone. Because you're up 26.96 and you should celebrate. $100 on a kicker. Any kicker. Spend it before it expires. I don't think it expires, but neither do my coupons and I still panic.

5. Br0phy, you're up 10.1 to 0.0. Bench everyone. Lock it in. If no one on Dude, Your Getting a Dell plays, nobody can score less. I've run this play in three different leagues and been kicked out of two of them.

exits.t: Scored 8.1 on the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte bench in Week 10 while AJ Barner started at superflex and scored 5.9. Bill_Buttlicker lost by 117.42 and has since started Brenton Strange and Juwan Johnson ahead of him. Has asked for a manager who knows superflex means quarterback.

Scored 14.2 on the Catfan94’s Farm Team bench in Week 10 while Zonovan Knight started and scored 2.4. This week jrsmith1391 started Myles Price, a Wednesday pickup, over him at receiver. Would like to know what a guy has to do.

Scored 3.7 on the Hold My DK taxi squad Thursday night while Laquon Treadwell, added 93 minutes before kickoff, started at receiver and scored 0.0. Has asked to be told what he has to do to get promoted.
Caught a 24-yard touchdown for 11.5 points on The Champ bench Thursday. TJohn91 spent the week stashing Tai Felton on the taxi squad instead. Boutte would like a manager who watches his games.
Scored 14.9 on the I Chase Brown Kids bench in Week 10 while Javonte Williams started and scored 8.2. Would like to be traded to a team with fewer quarterbacks and more lineup spots for him.
Scored 9.4 on the Bourbon Lover bench in Week 10 while Demarcus Robinson (0.0) and Keon Coleman (2.1) started. Bourbon Lover lost by 7.54. Jeudy has done the math.

facts: TJohn91 has won both titles on Sleeper. He went 12-2 in 2024 and 10-4 in 2025.
Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts, the most in the league. JAY2913 is next with six.
Catfan94's 243.58 in Week 5 this year is the highest score in league history, and his 232.54 in Week 10 is second. Nobody else has topped 198.64.
Bill_Buttlicker went 3-11 in 2024 and 4-10 in 2025, scored 54.86 in 2024 Week 3, the second-lowest score in league history, and is 10-28 all time.
Br0phy's 39.26 in Week 8 this year is the lowest score in league history by 14.78 points. Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0-10.
